_class.description: Class name of the object (typically reflects the node type).

actions.description: A list of action objects, each with unique properties based on the action.

executors.description: List of executor objects, containing data about each job’s status and progress.

idle.description: Boolean indicating if the node is currently idle.

jnlpAgent.description: Boolean indicating if the node connects via JNLP.

launchSupported.description: Indicates if launching is supported on this node.

loadStatistics.description: Object containing load statistics like queue length and busy executors.

manualLaunchAllowed.description: Boolean indicating if manual launch is allowed.

monitorData.description: Contains monitoring data for disk, memory, and response time.

numExecutors.description: Number of executors on this node.

temporarilyOffline.description: Boolean indicating if the node is temporarily offline.
